title: Filipino bound for Russia intercepted at Mactan airport – BI

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Filipino bound for Russia for an alleged security-related job offer was intercepted at the Mactan-Cebu International Airport, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said on Sunday. According to the BI, a 50-year-old Filipino was intercepted at the airport as he attempted to depart via Cathay Pacific flight to Vietnam last Oct. 10.
